## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Include a local regression test and screenshots for UI changes. State any checks not run.

## Security and compatibility

Describe changes to authentication, public API behavior, schema, dependencies, or workflows. Confirm no secrets, private identifiers, personal data, or runtime databases are included.

## Agent assistance

If applicable, describe agent assistance and confirm your user authorized the public contribution. Do not include private conversation logs.
